references.subject: Renukacharya (Renukasiddha): appearance and the emergence iconography
leads: Script and K1 Siddhanta Shikhamani 4.3-4: sacred ash over the body, rudraksha, staff (danda), water pot (kamandalu)
Panchacharya iconography is commonly described as a sage emerging from a Shivalinga (secondary sources; needs a primary or peetha-issued image)
references.use: character sheet C1, then E1, V1, V2, T1, T2, R1
references.rights: n/a until a reference is chosen
references.needed: One approved iconographic reference (for example a Veerashaiva peetha image) for face, hair, marks and dress. Also settle naming: some listings call the shrine 'Someshwara Revanasiddeshwara', and Revanasiddha is given as another name of Renukacharya. The script's own names are kept; this only checks that the figure drawn is the right one
